== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo)]] original and [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo) (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary 2.0). Appendix A matches that Glossary text; [[R2-Q2 (Artoo-Kyootoo) (PC Errata)]] redirects here. The published Holotable face is the E reconstruction of that Glossary rewrite, not a later PC column. Do not transclude onto Revised, Japanese, foil, or (V). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
